profile.headline: Software Engineer at Geoforce
profile.summary: Software engineer with a passion for design and user experience sparked by early exposure to engineering and a variety of technologies. I bring an optimistic, user-oriented approach, coupled with a creative mindset and meticulous attention to detail. Adaptable to both independent and collaborative environments, I embrace challenges as opportunities for growth. I'm always eager to learn and enjoy assisting fellow developers in their journey.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Collaboratively and independently develop and maintain SaaS fleet management web and mobile applications that handle an extensive amount data points delivered from a REST API for over 40,000 devices

Utilize React 17+ with Typescript, also implement and maintain concepts and packages like routing, authentication, hooks, websockets, React Query and Axios, Zustand, Styled Components, React Table, Google Maps, power bi, ChartJs, and D3 charts—and many more! 

Develop, maintain and deploy 3 React native applications for IOS/Android that integrate with the web application using XCode and Android Studio.

Localize both the web and mobile applications using i18next in Spanish, French-Canadian and Portuguese-Brazil

Enthusiastically explore new tools like Storybook and simultaneously learn and develop in languages like React Native and TypeScript, integrating innovative packages for enhanced app features and cohesion

Create, update and monitor unit tests in jest for performance optimization 

Provide UI/UX feedback as well as design mock ups, contribute to code reviews using Figma and Notion, ensure robustness through testing and compatibility measures

Known for clean, consistent, pixel-perfect, modular code and components

Often reducing files from 600+ lines to 200 or less, breaking out logic and components into helper files for ease of testing with cypress and jest

Regularly and thoroughly report bugs and resolution for future reference using Jira and Notion

Convert legacy code from JavaScript to TypeScript and create new components in Typescript

Convert class components to functional components and keep packages updated to follow best practices

Assist in mentoring newly hired developers with code base and business requirements

Ship out releases on a regular basis, weekly to biweekly and monitor CI/CD workflow

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Solely redesigned, developed and deployed a SaaS React web application reporting dashboard for cash handling analytics using AWS as well as a MVC API

Simultaneously planned and designed dashboard capabilities while learning React for development 

Iteratively refined the dashboard through three design prototypes, implementing feedback and adapting to new requirements using Adobe XD

Built and connected database schemas, triggers and services using T-SQL

Constructed, thoroughly documented and developed a MVC API using C#

Developed a single page web application that implemented JWT authentication, routing, websockets, React Query, EmailJS, Reactstrap, React DND, and ChartJS

Delivered the new application to production in 10 months, 2 months sooner than planned

positions.title: Branch Operations Manager
positions.description:
Hired and trained new associates for sales associates, warehouse manager, warehouse associates and driver positions, ensuring all complied within the standard set by Lansing, utilizing training tools and performance reviews

Evaluated and improved the branch performance; analyzed the P&L and inventory levels monthly with Branch Manager

Improved the audit score from failing to above the company’s average 

Lead weekly branch meetings that focused on areas of improvement, incorporating fun ways to challenge them in that week’s topic

Dispatched deliveries in the most efficient order, taking into consideration truck load capacity, customer requests and supply retrieval. 

Redesigned the showroom into a modern clean space that showcased best products, increasing sales and margin of special product categories.

Researched and negotiated with service providers

Attended the annual meeting at headquarters to further develop leadership skills

Managed payroll

Resolved customer issues and complaints

volunteerExperiences.description: Initiate and oversee seasonal drives – Toys for Tots, and food and clothing drives – both independently within LBP’s Elgin office, and corporately, as part of the Lansing Foundation, the community service sector of LBP

Planned and coordinated events with non-profit community service groups, such as the Air Force Association [ AFA ]; wrote articles to bring awareness to accomplishments of the detachment. Assisted in organizing STEM events, and marketing events to the public
